_comment: How Intercepta results are judged. All screening is on Base mainnet (chainId 8453) because Intercepta's risk data is mainnet-only; payments settle on Base Sepolia.
Which mainnet address stands in for each payTo lives in config/policy.json (screening.targets).
address_* thresholds are provisional: the official scam-and-risk-library page has not been checked yet (unreachable from the build container). Kept strict (BLOCK on any trait).
message.*_risk_groups must be filled from https://docs.web3antivirus.io/reference/scam-and-risk-library. Until then every riskGroup is unclassified -> UNAVAILABLE -> BLOCK (fail closed).
